customer_acme: Hey team — odd one. Our embed calls intermittently return different vector lengths. We expect 1536 but ~30% of responses are 1024. Happens only when our app is talking to a mix of Hosted + Dedicated + Private (we have fallback enabled).

customer_acme: Repro steps: send same batch (8 items) repeatedly. Sometimes all 8 are 1536, sometimes some are 1024. No error codes, just different embedding lengths which breaks downstream indexing.

customer_acme: Minimal curl we used:

customer_acme: ```
customer_acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{\"model\":\"open-embed-large\",\"input\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\",\"d\",\"e\",\"f\",\"g\",\"h\"]}'
customer_acme: ```

customer_acme: Example response (one request that showed mixed dims):

customer_acme: ```json
customer_acme: {
customer_acme:   \"data\": [
customer_acme:     {\"object\":\"embedding\",\"embedding\":[0.001, ...],\"index\":0},
customer_acme:     {\"object\":\"embedding\",\"embedding\":[0.002, ...],\"index\":1},
customer_acme:     {\"object\":\"embedding\",\"embedding\":[0.003, ...],\"index\":2}  // length 1536
customer_acme:   ],
customer_acme:   \"meta\": {\"model\":\"open-embed-large\",\"request_id\":\"req-abc123\"}
customer_acme: }
customer_acme: ```

alex_support: Thanks, filing this now. Can you paste the exact request_id for a mixed-response request? Also which region (us-west-2) and whether you were hitting a dedicated pool endpoint or hosted endpoint?

customer_acme: req-abc123, we mostly hit the hosted endpoint but our routing policy allows dedicated first, then hosted as fallback. Region: us-west-2.

mira_ml: Quick theory: sounds like a variant mismatch rather than noise. We recently onboarded two variants of open-embed-large — a v2 at 1536 and a legacy at 1024. If routing falls back to a different variant that’s a feature mismatch. Does the request include a pinned model_version?

customer_acme: No, we rely on model name only and rely on Redwood routing to pick best. We didn't expect dimension changes between variants.

ian_infra: Checking logs for req-abc123... I can see two downstream backends hit: dedicated-pool-3 (capacity throttled for a small window) then hosted-fallback-02.

ian_infra: dedicated-pool-3 served model open-embed-large-legacy (1024) — fallback served open-embed-large-v2 (1536). There is a catalog mismatch: dedicated cluster still has legacy variant as default.

alex_support: That explains the mixed dims. Two quick mitigations: 1) pin model_version in your request (e.g., model: \"open-embed-large@v2\") to force 1536, 2) set fallback_policy:no-fallback on route while we fix catalog alignment.

sophie_prod: Note — we shouldn't silently change dimensions across variants. Prod ask: prevent cross-variant fallback when vector dims differ. Can we add a compatibility check in smart routing?

mira_ml: Agreed. I'll open a feature ticket for routing-level compatibility checks. For now, infra can update dedicated pools to use v2 default or we can map legacy to a named alias.

ian_infra: Working on update. Quick patch: set dedicated-pool-3 default model to open-embed-large-v2; rolling deploy starting now. deploy-bot: \"deploy started -> infra/dedicated-model-defaults#341\"

deploy-bot: :rocket: deploy completed in 42s (dedicated-pool-3 default now open-embed-large-v2).

customer_acme: Thanks — after the change we retried the same curl 20x and got all 1536. Temporary workaround saved us.

customer_acme: One more eyebrow-raiser — we also saw a 401 once when the request was proxied to the Private cluster. Any idea?

ian_infra: Found that — Private deployment was validating a different API key prefix (they use org-scoped keys) and returned 401 before mapping to the routing layer; when your client retried with same token, routing sent to hosted and worked. That caused a one-off auth loop. We'll sync key mapping to avoid retries going to fallback on auth errors.

alex_support: TL;DR root causes: (a) model variant default mismatch between Dedicated and Hosted leading to dim shift during fallback, (b) Private cluster had a token validation mismatch causing auth -> retry -> fallback -> cost spike.

alex_support: Next steps we took: changed dedicated default, filed infra ticket to add routing compatibility checks, and added hotspot alert to catch mismatched-dim responses (alerts on any response length != expected for model). Also hooking product to consider policy: fail-fast on incompatible fallback rather than silent fallback.

sophie_prod: +1 on fail-fast. Also add a short KB for customers: how to pin model_version and set fallback_policy.

customer_acme: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Can you confirm whether we'll be billed for any hosted fallback calls that occurred? We saw a billing spike during the incident window.

alex_support: Billing team will reconcile — we'll file an internal billing review and DM you. For immediate relief, we can issue a credit for the obvious spike while we investigate.

mira_ml: Follow-up: we'll also push a short-term server-side guard — if fallback model has different embedding dimension, return 409 with friendly error instead of silently returning different dims. That should prevent silent data corruption for indexers.

customer_acme: That would be ideal. Thanks everyone. We'll test the pinned-model approach and report back if anything else crops up. :thumbsup:
